response.sql: WITH filtered_data AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as match_count FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ab.peercorr >= 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist), totals_per_ordertype AS (SELECT ordertypedist, SUM(match_count) as total_for_ordertype FROM filtered_data GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT fd.translink, fd.ordertypedist, fd.match_count, fd.match_count::numeric / tpo.total_for_ordertype::numeric as fraction FROM filtered_data fd JOIN totals_per_ordertype tpo ON fd.ordertypedist = tpo.ordertypedist ORDER BY (fd.match_count::numeric / tpo.total_for_ordertype::numeric) DESC LIMIT 10
